highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 previews Skia m152 with Graphite bindings and asynchronous pixel readback.
highlights_body: It improves resource safety, adds Vulkan Silk.NET package support, and broadens native assets across supported platforms.

bullets.detail: Carries the m152 engine update and subsequent servicing fixes.

bullets.lead: Graphite and asynchronous pixel readback APIs added
bullets.detail: Adds Graphite backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, plus backend-neutral asynchronous pixel readback on images and surfaces.

bullets.lead: Native lifetime fixes prevent use-after-free conditions
bullets.detail: Roots pixel and region sources correctly and releases failed raster-image allocations and HarfBuzz stream assets.
Restores the Vulkan Silk.NET package, adds Apple symbols, and provides FreeType-backed font support on Nano Server.

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 introduced m152, Graphite bindings, asynchronous pixel readback, and broad lifecycle improvements.
preview_summaries.v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14: Release Candidate 1 added m152 servicing fixes and completed native symbol and package delivery.

harfbuzz_summary: Improves HarfBuzz shaping allocation behavior and stream lifetime handling while updating package and platform delivery.
